sources.title: Visa regime for foreigners
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Moldova
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official MFA page returned HTTPS 200 and publishes both the required-visa and exempt-nationality schedules.

conflicts.officialStatus: unresolved: the same current MFA page lists Dominican Republic as both required-visa [2] and visa-exempt
conflicts.explanation: Footnote [2] only exempts holders of a qualifying EU, Schengen, UK, United States or Canadian visa or residence permit; it cannot reconcile the unconditional exempt-list entry or establish a passport-only electronic route.

unresolved.reason: Moldova MFA's current primary page places Dominican Republic in both the required-visa [2] and exempt lists. The conditional third-country-document exception is excluded; no current treaty, decision or Dominican passport-authority source resolves the ordinary-passport baseline or issuance timing.
